summary.headline: Zodiacal Hours and Stellar Restitutions
summary.text: Chapters 50–52 discuss calculating zodiacal-sign additions and clime hours, the maximum restitutions of the seven stars and cosmic restitution, and the effects of the Moon being unconnected to the Sun or Saturn. The apparatus cites Ptolemy, Lydus, Michael Psellus, Nicetas Acominatus, Berossus, Seneca, Kroll, and Heraclitus.
